subject: MATHEMATICS
purpose: Synthesize coherent teaching buckets from the exact capability-level Core1 plan and exact M-F learner StudyModel, then realize those buckets as a learner-facing textbook manuscript and PDF without changing learner diagnosis/treatment or mathematical authority.

binding_invariants: Core1 capability coverage == StudyModel capability coverage
Core1 treatment == StudyModel treatment for every capability
Core1 scope_role == StudyModel scope_role for every capability
Core1 assessment-question bindings == StudyModel bindings for every capability
forbidden: original assessment-question reuse as Core1A worked/practice instance

bucket_synthesis.direct_grouping_rule: Group directly assessed capabilities only when they share governed problem-family authority.
bucket_synthesis.prerequisite_attachment_rule: Attach prerequisite-only capability to one dependent bucket only when the dependency is unambiguous; shared prerequisites remain their own bridge bucket.
bucket_synthesis.ordering_rule: Use approved Core1 capability order as the stable bucket-order basis; do not invent difficulty ordering.
learning_atom_grounding: bound PCK anchor or ordinary-language bridge

full_teaching_requirements.hint_policy: GUIDED exposes at most two hints, FADED at most one hint, INDEPENDENT and TRANSFER expose no hint in the main learner flow.
